title: Federal Rule Lifecycle Resolver input
description: Identify one federal rulemaking. Provide at least one field. Several identifiers are cross-checked; incompatible identifiers return status conflicting_identifiers (not charged).

federalRegisterUrl.title: Federal Register URL
federalRegisterUrl.description: A federalregister.gov/documents/... URL; the document number is read from it.

query.title: Rule name (natural language)
query.description: Rule title or name, e.g. "Oil and Natural Gas Sector Climate Review". Resolved only when one rulemaking clearly dominates; otherwise status ambiguous with up to 5 candidates (not charged).
query.prefill: Oil and Natural Gas Sector Climate Review

agency.title: Agency (optional)
agency.description: Agency name or federalregister.gov slug to narrow a natural-language query, e.g. "Environmental Protection Agency".
